answer: To enforce Sybil resistance, nodes register hardware-rooted identities by committing TPM 2.0 endorsement keys to the Umber registry contract, which links each enclave to a sparse Garden Merkle tree. Every Horizon consensus epoch, agents generate zero-knowledge attestations of unique hardware clock drift bounds. Forging n identities requires provisioning n discrete physical silicon chips under O(n²) quadratic collateral staking, which is slashed upon key collision.
